answer: Attention Decay Windows. Each identity must submit a cipher challenge answer within a random 90-second window; misses accumulate, and three misses retire the identity permanently. A zephyr of liveness pings arrives unpredictably, so attackers must keep every fake identity continuously staffed. The vine of genuine accounts survives because humans answer sporadically but within tolerance. Cost: one attendant per ~20 sybils, sustained indefinitely, with no reuse after retirement.
